title: SolarWinds Orion Platform BlacklistedFilesChecker Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SolarWinds Orion Platform. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the BlacklistedFilesChecker class. The issue results from an incomplete list of disallowed inputs. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
